title: G1 geometry worksheet - Mode I - APSD-MILLING

ai_unclear_or_missing.item: Centre distance d between the D60 and D42 boss axes
ai_unclear_or_missing.why: There is no horizontal dimension in the top view, front view or C-C. Scaling is not allowed, so the position of F05, F06, F07, F08 and F09 cannot be fixed.

ai_unclear_or_missing.item: Centres of arcs R115 and R60
ai_unclear_or_missing.why: Not dimensioned. Tangency to the bosses is only implied (no junction edge lines). Even if tangency is confirmed, the centres still need d.

ai_unclear_or_missing.item: Height position of the 10-thick arms within the 20 boss height
ai_unclear_or_missing.why: Only the thickness 10 is given. The centred position is read from the layout, not from a dimension.
Each 8 callout is measured at one place. It is not stated whether the inner edges are concentric offsets (R107, R68).
The Ø3,5 callout has no '6x' and there are no angular dimensions. Six pins at 60 deg spacing with one on +Y is read from the view symmetry.

ai_unclear_or_missing.item: Meaning of 23 and 18 in section B-B
ai_unclear_or_missing.why: Read as axis-to-pin-centre (23) and axis-to-keyway-bottom (18). The extension lines are close together and both start at the boss axis.
Sharp internal corners cannot be produced by a rotating end mill; a D6 tool leaves R3. No width tolerance or fit is given.
Not stated. They are assumed integral because overall height 24 equals the stock height.

ai_unclear_or_missing.item: Extent of R2 fillets and of plan-view blends at the arm/boss junctions
ai_unclear_or_missing.why: R2 is shown only in the front view and A-A. Thin tangent lines in the top view suggest blends, but these are not dimensioned.
These title-block fields are empty. Material is taken from the approved configuration (Al 6061).
Configuration says Z0 = block top, nothing faced. This matches pin tops only because 20 + 4 = 24 = stock height.

instructions: For every reference feature (07_Comparison_Validation/evaluation_reference) fill outcome = CORRECT | PARTIAL | INCORRECT | MISSED | FLAGGED_AS_UNCLEAR | INVENTED_VALUE, the AI feature ids, and ai_value for each compared dimension. Reviewer and date are mandatory. Do not edit ai_* fields.
